description: Orientation for deploying an app on redu.cloud: the end-to-end flow, the two source modes (git vs upload), how to handle a missing Dockerfile or a database, when (and when NOT) to split a deploy across multiple VMs, verifying a deploy functionally, and how to debug a failed build. Call this first when a user asks to deploy/ship/host an app and you're unsure where to start.
name: deploy_overview
title: How to deploy an app on redu (start here)
